checks.text: A buyer whose order was sent can report 'there was a card or leaflet in the package' from the order page
It is counted apart from ordinary complaints on the seller's record
The seller can say it is solved or cannot be solved, and cannot 'take it back' (nothing is sent back)
The owner can only close the case, and uses a penalty step if it is true; a return case beside it still has 'Send it back to the seller'

shots.caption: The buyer's order page: waiting for the seller
The owner's cases page: only 'Close the case'

did: Reported a card in the package as the buyer, answered it as the seller, and read it as the owner.
